description: Estimate the credit cost of scraping a URL before you run it. Use when cost matters or before a large job; no credits are charged. Returns the predicted tier, estimated cost and confidence. Full machine-readable price list: GET https://alterlab.io/api/v1/pricing (public, no auth).

mode.description: Scraping mode: auto (recommended), html, js (headless browser), pdf, or ocr Default: auto.

render_js.description: Render JavaScript with a headless browser. Default: false.

use_proxy.description: Route through a premium proxy. Default: false.

name: alterlab_estimate_cost
title: Estimate Scrape Cost
